The wallet node did not start

Mabel runs its wallet node inside this app and shows the page that node serves. This page is what you see when the node could not bind its listeners or could not open its home.

The reason is in the app's log. On macOS, run the binary from a terminal to read it: /Applications/Mabel.app/Contents/MacOS/Mabel.

A home whose node.key is readable by other users is refused on purpose. Quit the app, fix the permissions to 0600, and start it again.
